summary: Awesome is an impressed, wide-eyed sign; common versions include an open hand shaking at the wrist or a fist pulling down with a satisfied face. The clip shows one widely used form.
steps: Watch the clip for the handshape and placement.
Match the energy: eyebrows up, mouth slightly open.
Sign it fast and bright. AWESOME done slowly looks sarcastic.
mistakes: Flat face. The expression is the sign.
